sloka: पुरा किल महाबाहो तपस्वी सत्य वाक् शुचिः ।कस्मिन् चित् अभवत् पुण्ये वने रत मृग द्विजे ॥३-९-१६॥
transliteration: purā kila mahābāho tapasvī satya vāk śuciḥ ।kasmin cit abhavat puṇye vane rata mṛga dvije ॥3-9-16॥

translations.english: A bow in the hand of a kshatriya is like fuel to fire. It surely swells his strength and his brilliance.
